description.value: Ross Creek Country Store is a full-service country store and fuel station in Magna Bay on the sunny North Shuswap, operating alongside a family campground nestled among trees near Shuswap Lake. The store stocks groceries, fresh deli, a bakery, hot takeout meals, ice cream, camping and BBQ supplies, and propane, making it a remarkably comprehensive resupply stop along the Squilax-Anglemont Road. Touring cyclists can eat at outdoor picnic tables with WiFi access, and the adjacent campground offers a place to stay the night.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at rosscreekcampground.com is a rich, active site fully describing both the country store and adjacent campground. Store page confirms groceries, hot food, ice, and propane/camping fuel. Contact page corroborates OSM address (6929 Squilax Anglemont Rd.) and phone (250-679-4082). No explicit mention of bike-specific parking or water bottle refill service, so those remain null.
concerns: The website's primary branding is 'Ross Creek Family Campground' while OSM records the name as 'Ross Creek Country Store'; both names appear on the website and refer to the same combined operation, so no action needed but worth noting.
Website URL (rosscreekcampground.com) was discovered rather than listed in OSM tags, though confidence is high and content clearly matches the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational business with active website, confirmed address and phone, offering groceries, hot food, fuel, and a campground — a valuable stop for touring cyclists on the North Shuswap.
